title: What must a worker prove before handing off a Task result?
question: What must a worker prove before handing off a Task result?
answer:
WF-8: Tasks use red/green TDD, make relevant tests green, exercise what was built to confirm it works, and preserve proof before handoff. A separate context checks the assembled Spec. Integration is the assembled surface for owner Human QA, which can return work to Align before owner-only main promotion.
WF-8B: No per-Task independent-review ceremony just because it is a Task. Ordinary verification and proof are mandatory: red/green TDD, relevant tests green, exercising what was built, and preserved proof before handoff.
SCR-1: No separate-context QA or approval gate on a Task. A Task is a small one-time instruction: do the bounded step, update proof that Actuality moved closer to the destination, report back, end. The Worker self-checks that its claims are valid and backed by proof before hand-back; destination-level QA waits until the Spec is assembled.
